brief: Over-dramatic young female anime ninja heroine with a light East Asian accent, intense whispers that explode into shouts, heavy breaths, emphasis like a shonen anime English dub

lines.v_kimi_line: One trillion parameters. Thirty-two billion of them are awake. Enough.
lines.v_kimi_taunt0: Moon punch. From the far side.
lines.v_kimi_taunt1: I read your entire fighting history. All two million tokens.
lines.v_kimi_taunt2: Agent swarm: engaged. Three hundred of me.
lines.v_kimi_low0: The moon wanes... then it comes back. Always.
lines.v_kimi_winq2: One trillion parameters. You needed only one.
